ios.desc:
Turn any photo or video into living ASCII art.

ASCII Studio rebuilds your photos and videos out of characters, dots, blocks and lines, then brings them to life with motion. Pick a photo or a clip, choose a style, tune it, and export a still, a looping video or a GIF in seconds.

EVERY ASCII STYLE IS FREE
• 10 styles: Characters, Dots, Block, Dither, Mixed, Pixel Art, Mosaic, Diamond, Lines and Diagonal
• 17 character sets, from classic @#S08 to Braille, Binary, Math and Katakana, or type your own
• Color palettes: original color, mono, terminal green, amber, cyan, paper and more
• Strength slider to blend the look with your original

VIDEO TO ASCII
• Turn any clip from your library into ASCII art
• Trim to the moment you want, with a looping preview
• Keep your sound: audio is carried into the exported video
• Export as MP4 or GIF
• Save photo animations as a Live Photo

BRING IT TO LIFE
• Animations like Ripple, Wave, Scan, Glitch, Rain, Typewriter, Flicker and Breathe
• Control speed, intensity, randomness and loop length
• Depth: ASCII that follows the shape of your scene, estimated on your device

EDIT LIKE A PHOTO APP
• Crop, rotate, flip, exposure, contrast, saturation, warmth, filters, sharpness and vignette
• Unlimited undo and redo, plus a full history you can jump back to
• Hold to compare with the original at any time
• Copy a look and paste it onto another edit
• Your edits save automatically

SHARE YOUR WAY
• PNG, JPEG, MP4, GIF, Live Photo, plain text or HTML
• Copy your art as text
• iPad keyboard shortcuts for export, playback, tools and undo

ASCII STUDIO PRO
Unlock 82 Pro effects in seven groups: Distort, Glass, Blur & Light, Paint & Print, Color, Screen & Glitch and Pattern. Fluted glass, kaleidoscope, risograph, halftone, CRT, datamosh, pixel sort and many more. Every effect can be animated and exported. Subject cutout is also part of Pro. Try any effect free on your own photo before you subscribe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad. Your photos and videos are never uploaded, there's no account, and nothing is tracked.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
ASCII Studio Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends.
